title: MCP Inspector
oneLiner: Visual testing tool for Model Context Protocol servers.
summary: MCP Inspector is a developer tool from the Model Context Protocol project for testing MCP servers visually while building or debugging agent integrations.
whyItMatters: As MCP adoption grows, builders need a fast way to inspect tools, resources, prompts, and server behavior before connecting an agent to production systems.
bestFor: Builders validating MCP capabilities before exposing them to an agent
notFor: Users who only need a hosted plugin marketplace
Teams that are not using Model Context Protocol
